cues.en: I've been teaching for about 25 years at this point, and I've spent a lot of time thinking about teaching,
cues.zh: 到現在，我教學大約已經 25 年，也花了很多時間思考教學，

cues.en: about how to teach, how to interact with my students, how to design my courses and learning materials.
cues.zh: 思考如何教、如何與學生互動、如何設計課程與學習教材。

cues.en: And it's an ongoing process.
cues.zh: 而這是一個持續進行的過程。

cues.en: I'm not done learning how to teach, and I'm always trying to understand my students better.
cues.zh: 我對如何教學的學習還沒結束，也一直努力更了解學生。

cues.en: And there are a few fundamental things about teaching that I have learned, two of which I want to share with you now.
cues.zh: 關於教學，我學到了幾個根本的道理，現在想與你分享其中兩個。

cues.en: First is that teachers cannot teach.
cues.zh: 第一，老師無法把知識直接教進你的腦中。

cues.en: No teacher can teach you something.
cues.zh: 沒有老師能代替你學會某件事。

cues.en: Students can learn.
cues.zh: 學生能夠學習。

cues.en: You can learn.
cues.zh: 你能夠學習。

cues.en: But I cannot teach you anything.
cues.zh: 但我無法替你學會任何事情。

cues.en: Only you can get the information into your head.
cues.zh: 只有你自己，能把資訊放進自己的腦中。

cues.en: Now, the only thing that teachers can do is try to provide good information, provide good materials,
cues.zh: 老師唯一能做的，就是努力提供好的資訊、好的教材，

cues.en: and equally importantly, try to help motivate and encourage the students to stick with it and push themselves.
cues.zh: 同樣重要的是，努力激發學生的動機，鼓勵學生堅持下去、挑戰自己。

cues.en: All of this means is that we, both, you and me, we share responsibility for your learning.
cues.zh: 這一切的意思是，我們兩個，你和我，共同對你的學習負責。

cues.en: I try to do my best to create and provide material, but at the end of the day, only you can put that information into your head.
cues.zh: 我盡力製作並提供教材，但說到底，只有你能把那些資訊放進自己的腦中。

cues.en: And that leads me to the second thing that I have learned about teaching, and that is that no two students are the same.
cues.zh: 這就帶到我學到的第二個教學道理：沒有兩個學生完全相同。

cues.en: And that means that no single teaching resource can ever be perfect.
cues.zh: 因此，沒有任何單一的教學資源，能夠對所有人都完美適用。

cues.en: And well, you know, I try to make my courses and my lectures, my slides, my codes and my books to be as approachable and understandable as I can make them.
cues.zh: 我努力讓課程、講解、投影片、程式碼與書籍，盡可能親切易懂。

cues.en: And I know that my approach of teaching works well for many students.
cues.zh: 我也知道，我的教學方式對許多學生很有效。

cues.en: But I also know, to be honest, I know that it absolutely falls flat on its face for some students.
cues.zh: 但老實說，我也知道，對某些學生而言，它完全不管用。

cues.en: And there's other students who learn a little bit from my teaching style, but it's not really the right fit for them.
cues.zh: 還有一些學生能從我的教學風格中學到一點，但這種風格並不真正適合他們。

cues.en: That's fine.
cues.zh: 這沒關係。

cues.en: That's how it is, and I accept that.
cues.zh: 事實就是如此，我也接受。

cues.en: And so basically what that means is that the best way for you to learn is by sampling from multiple
cues.zh: 所以，基本上，最好的學習方式，就是接觸多個

cues.en: different sources and integrating them in a way that works best for you.
cues.zh: 不同來源，再以最適合自己的方式整合它們。

cues.en: So apropos this course, if you really want to learn calculus, then I mean, first of all, that's
cues.zh: 回到這門課，如果你真的想學微積分，首先，

cues.en: amazing and congratulations on just having that goal and acting on it.
cues.zh: 這非常棒。光是有這個目標，並且付諸行動，就值得恭喜。

cues.en: But I think it's foolish to try to learn only from my course and not from other courses or other books.
cues.zh: 不過，我覺得只想從我的課學習，而不看其他課程或書籍，是不明智的。

cues.en: Obviously, I hope you find that this course is comprehensive and fun and engaging and worth your time investment.
cues.zh: 當然，希望你覺得這門課完整、有趣、引人入勝，而且值得投入時間。

cues.en: But I really do encourage you to get different perspectives on the same topic from different instructors and different authors.
cues.zh: 但我真的鼓勵你，從不同講師與作者那裡，了解同一個主題的不同觀點。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Well, I could go on and on about this topic, but I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 這個主題我還能說上很久，不過我想你明白了。

cues.en: Let's get back to learning calculus.
cues.zh: 回到微積分的學習吧。
